policy: A review is keyed by BCD path, engine and the digest of the note text; a changed note is unreviewed again.
Full statements: irrelevant means the note does not limit the emitted use; restricts means native for the emitted use with the restriction recorded in every record; blocking means incompatible.

Partial statements (partial: true): native only with a review that names the missing sub-behavior (missing) and states why the usage the compiler emits does not depend on it (rationale). Without such a review a partial statement is unknown.
effectiveFrom: the review applies only to floors at or above that release; below it the note is unreviewed and the outcome is unknown.
properties: a property-scoped review accepts only records scoped to one of these properties; any other property is refused on that engine.
Notes on statements that never apply to an announceable floor are left unreviewed and therefore fail closed if they ever apply.

reviews.missing: The engine does not adjust the tinted control to keep a minimum contrast for legibility.
reviews.rationale: accent-color is emitted with a design-system color token; the engine applies that accent to checkboxes, radios, ranges and progress. Only automatic contrast correction is missing, and choosing a legible accent is the design-system author's responsibility in every engine. Recorded restriction.

reviews.missing: No effect on a scroll container that has no scrollable overflow: such a container does not contain scroll chaining.
reviews.rationale: The emitted declaration sets overscroll-behavior on a scroll container; every accepted use (CE-00.2 .grid-scroll and .sidebar, both overflow:auto) contains scroll chaining for a container whose content overflows, which partial engines do. Containment of a container without scrollable overflow (for example a scroll lock on a non-scrolling overlay) is not an emitted pattern of the accepted corpus and stays a recorded restriction.

reviews.missing: Inside ::marker only color and font-size are applied; every other property (font-weight, content, font-family, ...) is ignored.
reviews.rationale:
The selector itself matches and applies color and font-size, so a ::marker rule that declares only those properties renders as specified. Each other declared property is evaluated as its own combination (combination:selector:::marker+property:

) and refused on this engine.
